contexts.text: He shall be a servant unto tribute () = that he may have merit. Explained, Illustrated.
Princes of tributes () = the falsities which would compel them to serve... Tributes = servitudes. AC 6852:end.
Thou shalt not steal... extends to fraudulent practices in paying contributions and taxes.

The public dues of charity are especially contributions and taxes... They who are spiritual pay these... from good will, because they are collected for the preservation of their country, and for its protection and that of the Church, also for the administration of government... Therefore they to whom their country and also the Church are their neighbour, pay them with a spontaneous will, and regard it as iniquitous to deceive and to prevent their collection. But they to whom their country and the Church are not the neighbour, pay them with a reluctant will, and at every opportunity defraud... Char 187, Explained.
His young men shall be for tribute () = that the truth shall be subservient to falsities.
To give tribute and toll () = to be subject and to serve; and therefore tributes were imposed on foreigners... AE 820:5.
